$comment: Pinned dataset snapshots for the benchmark harness (gate G4). Raw data under raw/ is git-ignored; this metadata is the pin. Loaders in 03a read this manifest and must verify bytes against these hashes.

cord-v2.role: layout-stress bucket, out-of-language (DQ-04/ADR-010): Indonesian labels, never mixed into headline English accuracy
cord-v2.acquisition: six parquet files downloaded to raw/cord-v2/; sha256 of each verified against the Hugging Face LFS content identifier
cord-v2.labelCoverageNote: item name/quantity/unit price/line total + subtotal/total read from CORD menu structures; fields the parser does not support are excluded from scoring by the 03a loader, never null-scored
cord-v2.status: acquired: all six parquet files in raw/cord-v2/ verified byte-exact against these SHA-256 hashes (Hugging Face LFS content identifiers), 2.3 GB total

sroie.role: grand-total-only contract: company/date/address/item_total fields are the annotated scope; no itemized scoring anywhere
sroie.source: ICDAR 2019 SROIE Track A — canonical distribution at https://cvl.tiensit.com/data/sroie/ (site unreachable at pinning time; dataset release requires signing the consent form)
sroie.labelCoverageNote: item_total only for monetary scoring; absent fields are excluded, never null-scored
sroie.status: BLOCKED — awaiting owner acquisition via consent form. A non-canonical community mirror exists (huggingface.co/datasets/darentang/sroie) but is NOT adopted: per G4 the canonical snapshot is required, and adopting a mirror is an owner decision. Record source URL, version and sha256 here when obtained (risk R10).
